## Lecture outline

::: {.lec-outline}
::: {.lec-group}
### Example 1: heated-air process

- Takagi-Sugeno system identification
- Eleven-step identification workflow using a heated-air process
- Data preparation
- Linear baseline modeling
- Fuzzy operating regions
- Fuzzy rules
- Local dynamic models
- Weighted blending
- Model validation
- Free-run versus one-step-ahead prediction
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### Example 2: power-system frequency response

- Power-system frequency response
- Two-input fuzzy rule base
- Weighted least-squares estimation
:::

::: {.lec-group}
### MATLAB implementation

- Nineteen-part MATLAB implementation
- Data generation
- Model estimation
- Validation metrics
:::
